content_md:
CISA adds node2shell (broccoli2shell?) CVE-2026-111497 (Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value) and Adobe Commerce/Magento unrestricted file u

via Mastodon https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/10/27/cisa-adds-two-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog

CVE-2026-111497.evidence: CISA added CVE-2026-111497 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-27.

CVE-2026-48356.evidence: CISA added CVE-2026-48356 (Adobe Commerce/Magento unrestricted file upload) to the KEV catalog on 2026-10-27.
